name: Gum-Gum Fruit
description: The user's body becomes rubber: it stretches, bounces, and shrugs off blunt blows and lightning.

weaknesses.text: A rubber body soaked in water loses its bounce.

secret.name: Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika
secret.text: It was never a Paramecia: it is a Mythical Zoan, the fruit of the Sun God, which the World Government renamed and hid.

awakening: The rubber spreads to the ground and the air: the world itself turns to rubber around the user.

holders.name: Monkey D. Luffy
holders.how: ate it out of Shanks's chest

start.note: Held by the World Government, under another name

name: Chop-Chop Fruit
description: The user's body splits into pieces that float apart and fly at will; slashing does nothing.

weaknesses.text: Each piece can still be crushed or held.

holders.name: Buggy
holders.how: swallowed it by accident aboard Roger's ship

name: Slip-Slip Fruit
description: The user's skin is so smooth that blows slide off it.

name: Bomb-Bomb Fruit
description: Any part of the user's body, and anything that leaves it, can explode.

name: Kilo-Kilo Fruit
description: The user can change their weight from one kilo to ten thousand.

name: Flower-Flower Fruit
description: The user can sprout copies of their limbs from any surface, like flowers.

name: Wax-Wax Fruit
description: The user makes wax that sets as hard as steel.

name: Munch-Munch Fruit
description: The user can eat anything, and take on the shape of what they ate.

name: Clone-Clone Fruit
description: A touch of the right hand lets the user copy someone's face and body.

name: Dice-Dice Fruit
description: Any part of the user's body can turn into a blade of steel.

name: Spike-Spike Fruit
description: The user can grow spikes from anywhere on their body.

name: Bind-Bind Fruit
description: Whatever the user's arms pass through is bound in iron shackles.

name: Spring-Spring Fruit
description: The user's legs and arms become springs.

name: Slow-Slow Fruit
description: The user fires beams that make anything they hit move thirty times slower for thirty seconds.

weaknesses.text: A mirror sends the beam back.

name: Door-Door Fruit
description: The user can open doors in anything, even in the air.

name: Bubble-Bubble Fruit
description: The user makes soap bubbles that wash away strength and footing.

name: Berry-Berry Fruit
description: The user's body can break into berry-sized spheres.

name: Rust-Rust Fruit
description: Any metal the user touches rusts away.

name: Wheel-Wheel Fruit
description: The user can turn parts of their body into spinning wheels.

name: Revive-Revive Fruit
description: The user comes back once from death; later the soul can leave the body and chill whatever it touches.

name: Shadow-Shadow Fruit
description: The user controls shadows, cuts them from their owners and puts them into other bodies.

name: Hollow-Hollow Fruit
description: The user makes ghosts that pass through people and drain their will to live.

name: Clear-Clear Fruit
description: The user and whatever they touch can turn invisible.

name: Paw-Paw Fruit
description: Paws on the user's palms repel anything: air, pain, fatigue, even a person across the sea.

name: Art-Art Fruit
description: The user turns people and things into works of modern art.

name: Love-Love Fruit
description: Anyone who feels lust for the user can be turned to stone.

holders.name: Boa Hancock
holders.how: ate it while a slave in Mary Geoise

name: Venom-Venom Fruit
description: The user makes and controls every kind of poison.

name: Horm-Horm Fruit
description: The user controls hormones: sex, temperament, growth, healing.

name: Snip-Snip Fruit
description: The user's hands are scissors that cut anything like paper.

name: Tremor-Tremor Fruit
description: The user makes quakes: in the air, in the ground, in the sea. The strongest Paramecia, it was said, the power to destroy the world.
awakening: The quakes spread into the world: whole islands shake for a month.

holders.name: Marshall D. Teach
holders.how: stole it from Whitebeard's corpse at Marineford

name: Float-Float Fruit
description: The user can make anything they have touched float, except themselves; they fly on swords strapped to their legs.

name: Mark-Mark Fruit
description: Whatever the user throws at a marked target always hits it.

name: Arms-Arms Fruit
description: The user can turn any part of their body into any weapon.

name: Spin-Spin Fruit
description: The user can spin parts of their body like propellers, and fly.

name: Stick-Stick Fruit
description: The user makes a sticky, flammable mucus.

name: Barrier-Barrier Fruit
description: The user makes barriers nothing can break.

name: Stitch-Stitch Fruit
description: The user stitches anything to anything.

name: Glare-Glare Fruit
description: The user sees through anything and into minds, from far away.

name: Op-Op Fruit
description: Inside a ROOM the user makes, they can cut, swap and rearrange anything, a surgeon's god. Its last gift is eternal youth, at the cost of the user's life.

holders.name: Trafalgar Law
holders.how: was fed it by Corazon on Minion Island

start.note: A prize the Donquixote family meant to buy from the government

name: Stone-Stone Fruit
description: The user merges with stone and moves it as their own body.

name: Hobby-Hobby Fruit
description: A touch turns anyone into a toy, and everyone forgets they ever existed.

name: String-String Fruit
description: The user makes strings sharp enough to cut steel, and puppets people with them.
awakening: The strings spread into the ground and buildings: the whole town becomes string.

name: Calm-Calm Fruit
description: The user can silence any sound in a space around them.

name: Heal-Heal Fruit
description: The user's tears heal any wound.

name: Swim-Swim Fruit
description: The user can swim through the ground and walls as if through water.

name: Ton-Ton Fruit
description: The user can weigh many tons at will.

name: Flag-Flag Fruit
description: Whatever the user touches flutters like a flag, and stiffens again at their word.

name: Pop-Pop Fruit
description: The user makes their body and whatever they touch swell and burst.

name: Jacket-Jacket Fruit
description: The user becomes a jacket, and whoever wears it moves as the user wants.

name: Push-Push Fruit
description: The user pushes the ground and buildings about like clay.

name: Pump-Pump Fruit
description: The user's cheers turn ordinary people into fighters.

name: Heat-Heat Fruit
description: The user heats their body and whatever they touch.

name: Mirror-Mirror Fruit
description: The user opens doors into a world behind mirrors, and reflects attacks.

name: Biscuit-Biscuit Fruit
description: The user makes hard biscuits, and biscuit soldiers.

name: Soul-Soul Fruit
description: The user takes years from people's souls and puts them into things, which come alive as homies.

name: Cook-Cook Fruit
description: The user can cook anything at all into food.

name: Lick-Lick Fruit
description: The user makes hard candy and shapes it into anything.

name: Wring-Wring Fruit
description: The user wrings anything dry, people included, and drinks the juice.

name: Memo-Memo Fruit
description: The user can take memories out like film, cut them and splice them back.

name: Egg-Egg Fruit
description: Struck down, the user hatches into a stronger form.

name: Book-Book Fruit
description: The user can trap people inside the world of a book.

name: Genie-Genie Fruit
description: Rubbing their nose, the user summons a fighting genie.

name: Cream-Cream Fruit
description: The user makes scalding cream.

name: Butter-Butter Fruit
description: The user makes butter and slides on it.

name: Mochi-Mochi Fruit
description: A special Paramecia: the user becomes and makes sticky mochi, so close to a Logia that few can tell.
awakening: The mochi spreads into the ground and walls around the user.

name: Time-Time Fruit
description: The user can send themselves, and others, years into the future, but never back.

holders.name: Kozuki Toki
holders.how: ate it eight hundred years before, and leapt forward through time

name: Brush-Brush Fruit
description: Whatever the user draws comes to life.

name: Ripe-Ripe Fruit
description: The user ages and ripens anything they touch.

name: Millet-Millet Fruit
description: The user makes millet dumplings that tame any animal that eats one.

name: Clothes-Clothes Fruit
description: The user can turn anything into clothes and dress people in them.

name: Scroll-Scroll Fruit
description: The user stores things inside scrolls and releases them.

name: Castle-Castle Fruit
description: The user's body becomes a castle that holds people and cannons.

name: Tone-Tone Fruit
description: The user's body is an instrument, and its sound cuts and bursts.

name: Straw-Straw Fruit
description: The user becomes straw, and passes the wounds they take onto the people tied to their dolls.

name: Magnet-Magnet Fruit
description: The user makes magnetic force and pulls metal to themselves.
awakening: Whatever the user touches becomes magnetic too.

name: Press-Press Fruit
description: The user controls gravity: pressing armies flat, pulling meteors down from the sky.

name: Wash-Wash Fruit
description: The user washes people, and their hearts, and hangs them out to dry.

name: Twinkle-Twinkle Fruit
description: The user's body becomes diamond.

name: Brain-Brain Fruit
description: The user's brain can store limitless knowledge; their head grows with it.

name: Sick-Sick Fruit
description: The user spreads sickness, and can cure it.

name: Warp-Warp Fruit
description: The user can warp themselves and others from place to place.

name: Glug-Glug Fruit
description: The user drinks liquor and breathes it out as fire.

name: Big-Big Fruit
description: The user grows to a great size, far past any giant.

name: Isle-Isle Fruit
description: The user fuses with an island and moves it like their own body.

name: Strength-Strength Fruit
description: The user's strength grows far beyond their body.

name: Age-Age Fruit
description: The user changes their own age, and others', up and down.

name: More-More Fruit
description: The user can make anything a hundred times bigger or faster.
